S10 E11 — Door JamFrasier and Niles become obsessed by a new day spa, first with gaining entry, then gaining access to the spa's exclusive areas.

S16 E62 — Episode 62Develop your prowess in the kitchen with one of Australia’s most loved cooks, Justine Schofield. Along with an array of amazing guests Justine inspires cooks of all skill levels to be more ambitious and creative in their kitchens.
S4 E23 — Much Ado About NothingJohn is surprisingly flustered when he learns that his upbeat neighbour left town without saying goodbye, making Reggie a little jealous.
S10 E14 — Daphne Does DinnerDaphne believes that her throwing a party with Niles will prevent the usual Crane disasters associated with Frasier's hosting. However, it just makes matters worse.

S10 E15 — Trophy GirlfriendAfter winning a squash tournament partnered with gym teacher Chelsea, Frasier starts dating her. Seeing her on the job one day brings back nightmares of an abusive coach from his childhood.
S5 E22 — The One With Joey's Big BreakJoey and Chandler take a road trip to Las Vegas, where Joey has landed the lead role in a movie. Meanwhile, Rachel battles with an eye infection.

S5 E23 — The One In Vegas - Part 1The gang fly to Las Vegas to surprise Joey and to celebrate Monica's and Chandler's one-year anniversary. Ross and Rachel try to embarrass each other after an awkward encounter.
S5 E24 — The One In Vegas - Part 2Chandler and Monica reconcile and hastily decide to get married. Ross and Rachel get drunk and roam the casino. Phoebe deals with a 'lurker' on the slot machines.
S6 E1 — The One After VegasRoss and Rachel wake up with hangovers and married. Chandler and Monica don't get married, but he asks her if he can move in with her instead.
S2 E20 — I Always Wanted A Shaved MonkeyRose intervenes after Alan and Charlie come to blows over some of their unresolved issues.
S2 E21 — A Sympathetic Crotch To Cry OnAfter one of her ex-husbands dies, Evelyn summons Alan, Charlie and Jake to the funeral, where Charlie takes a keen interest in the widow.
S2 E22 — That Old Hose Bag Is My MotherAlan borrows money from Evelyn to buy a porsche. However, life doesn't become as glamorous as he expects.

A Melbourne principal's staffy Juno is fading fast. Chris brings her to Sydney for a CT scan revealing a condition so rare only 20 cases exist worldwide—her blood vessels are all mixed up and she needs high-risk surgery.

Ziggy the cat has a big problem - he weighs almost a third more than he should. Chris needs to re-educate both the cat and the devoted owner to ensure the cats' deteriorating health is not compromised further.

Chris heads to Cornwall, UK. He's flat-out treating a dairy calf needing urgent surgery, a prize-winning duck with a torn foot, and a Siberian eagle owl with a bung eye, and giving two Atlantic grey seals the all-clear for release.

In an emotion charged episode, Chris is on a desperate rescue mission to save the life of a frail 3-day old orphan foal. Brulee has lost his mum and won't survive unless Chris can find him a surrogate. But it's no guarantee a mare will accept the little foal.

Chris meets a labradoodle with a chronic sneezing problem. 2 year old Lulu suffers massive sneezing fits up to 4 times a day, and her devoted owner Kim is desperate for help. Chris fears Lulu may have a tumor.
Chris heads to Abu Dhabi after a special invitation to visit an extraordinary veterinary hospital, where sick and injured falcons are treated like royalty.

A tiny kitten has been found abandoned in a cardboard box, and Chris is shocked at the extent of her injuries. She desperately needs surgery to try to repair her shattered leg. Then it's a heartwarming search to find her a new home.
Chris's trip has an unforgettable encounter with some of China's precious Giant Pandas. Chris is granted the rare privilege of hand feeding some youngsters.

Chris is confronted with an unusual patient, an albino echidna. But there's a question mark over whether the extremely rare echidna is a male or a female. It will have to be anesthetized so Chris can investigate.

Tiny Amari has been born with a badly twisted back leg. At just 3 days old she's one of the youngest kittens Chris has ever seen at the clinic. Amari needs a series of splints to try to save her leg, and give her a second chance.

Travel to the Cook Islands as Chris helps out at a vet clinic where ill and injured pets abound. Princess needs help following a hit and run, and Mani the duck has lost a fight. A goat and a wolfhound round out the medical menagerie.
Chris is spending 2 weeks volunteering at the busy Esther Honey vet clinic in the Cook Islands. This week his first patient is a much-loved cat called Small One, which has part of its nose missing.

Chris makes a special trip to Karara to see Stubby, a tiny 3-week-old piglet, born with only one trotter. Stubby is struggling to get around. If the brave little battler is to survive, Chris needs to work out a way for her to walk normally.

Andrew investigates a worrying lump on a horse for a possible killer disease, but can he get close enough to find out? And Doctor Rachel is feeling the pressure when a passionate wildlife warrior brings in two distressed little Aussies.
Romi faces multiple emergencies when Lucy the groodle crashes before and during surgery, and Andrew treats a seriously ill goat that could be infested with a life-threatening parasite.

p.t: Just Getting Started - Bringing it Home
p.d: S1 E7Episode 7 of Just Getting Started covers the thrilling UCI race at Mont Sainte-Anne. The Norco Race Division team celebrated an amazing finish, with Gracey's top performance, Greg's strong UCI career finale, and Kirk's impressive 16th place. A weekend of passion, home support, and racing history!

p.t: Just Getting Started - The Life We Chose
p.d: S1 E1The first glimpse behind the scenes of the Norco Race Division on the opening weekend of the UCI Downhill World Cup in Fort William, Scotland. An unfiltered view into the life chosen by the team riders, led by the legendary Greg Minnaar, with access to the emotions, tribulations, and passion for the sport.

Way of the Ocean: Australia explores the connection between man and sea through a visual feast of poetic motion. This wave rich continent provides a breathtaking backdrop to some of the best surfing found on the planet. Since it was first introduced in the early 1900's, surfing in Australia has become a mainstream pursuit and for this country devoted to the ocean lifestyle, it is more than a way of life. From the tropical paradise of the Great Barrier Reef down through the frigid Southern Ocean and up to the arid desert of the West, the film captures an intimate portrait of this unique land. Vibrant super 16mm and High Definition cameras bring to life the stunning visuals, set to a heart thumping original score. Welcome to the odyssey of your life.

S1 E5The latest installment of Channel Island's WHAT'S GOING ON Series catches up with WSL World Tour surfer, Connor O'Leary in his adopted Northern Rivers home, in Australia. The goofy powerhouse samples some favorites from his extensive board quiver to catch some waves and shows some riding evidence of his reasons for loving them so much.

S1 E6Tom Carroll and Luca Elder break down the much talked about Channel Islands Twin Pin' surfboard model that both Tom and Luca have been riding. The surfers also share their favorite fin set ups and go catch a few waves to show why the twin-fins are making such a huge comeback.

S1 E1Join João as he explores new terrains, showcases thrilling action sports, and immerses himself in Portugal's stunning landscapes. Expect more adrenaline, epic rides, and unforgettable experiences in this exciting new season!

Mental Paradise is a contagious state of mind. Guided by Tanner Gudauskas' unmistakable grin, this 11-minute profile invites you to relax, let your thoughts drift, and come out the other side with a brighter perspective-and at the very least, a smile.

S1 E4Shannon soon to be having a baby let's Shayne fly out to New York to surf a hurricane swell before he gets put on diaper duty.  What Shayne finds juxtaposed in the big apple is a rich history of wave riding, unique surf culture, and tons of great waves.

S2 E5Larry wakes up "frazzled" and late for dish dog duty. Hunter loses his race to his friend and pro Joe Rich but learns something about himself. Cody gets busted for not wearing pads but still enjoys all the facilities at camp.
S2 E6The campers close out their final days of camp and have tons of fun. Cody , Larry , and Hunter all reflect back on their Camp Woodward experience.

S3 E5Built To Shred believes in recycling and in this episode host Jeff King and the crew put their recyclables to the test. Paper, plastic, metal, pallets, and even bullets become recyclable building blocks when Built To Shred gets hold of them.

S3 E6There's nothing better than a good backyard session with the boys, unless of course it's a backyard session with Tony Hawk and Rune Glifberg. The Built To Shred crew gives Tony and Rune's house an extreme shred makeover and the Birdhouse and Flip teams put their creations to the test.

p.d: S2 E5Just when you thought it was safe to go snowboarding in the park, in come European riders Jussi Oksanen and Mads Jonsson to take the sport to a new level.

TAPS investigates the The Garde Arts Center in New London, Connecticut. The theater was built on the site of the former Thomas Wheeler Williams mansion where five of his children died. There are several reports of a little girl with a balloon and one employee says an unseen force caught him when he fell from a ladder. The team encounters several mysterious sounds.
A homeowner’s property backs up to land where a cursed 1740’s village once stood.
A Museum Director and a volunteer are fearful that an upcoming Victorian exhibit about the Victorian Era and Spiritualism will uncover and agitate entities from that time period.
Jason and Grant investigate poltergeist activity in a home with a young girl who seems to see the spirits.
The team investigates the historic Mishler Theater and the Altoona Railroaders Memorial Museum.
The team investigates The Lighthouse Inn which is reported to be haunted by the ghost of a bride.

The T.A.P.S. crew investigate the Race Rock Lighthouse located in the Long Island Sound, off the coast of New London, Connecticut. The investigation proves unusually difficult not only because of a lack of electricity in the facility, but also the harsh conditions and strong undertow which surround the lighthouse.

T.A.P.S. investigates the Eastern State Penitentiary in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania which opened in 1829 and officially closed in 1970. During the investigation, the crew uncovers a piece of video footage so baffling, they are inspired to return again (in the same episode) for a two-night stay in order to gather more evidence.
This investigation focuses on some friends of Brian's whose home is a deconsecrated 19th century church.
TAPS investigates an armory in New Bedford, Mass. A camera detects a warm mist passing in front of the lens.

Reports of disturbances in a college student group house are easily explained as acoustics and encounters with neighbors who were drunk at the time.At the Topton House Pub, witnesses have reported that the ghost of a little girl sometimes trips people on the steps and has moved glasses of soda on one table. The daughter of the owner has also smelled roses while in the cellar and heard murmurring voices.The smells and voices are explained, and no evidence is found of any other paranormal activity.Jason shows Frank DeAngelis the footage from the Armory.
Mike Sinclair, the founder of O.R.I.O.N. Paranormal, has called in TAPS to co-investigate the New Boston Inn.
TAPS goes to Albany, NY to the home of Linda Johnson. Plus, they meet a man experiencing strange events.
TAPS goes to New Orleans to investigate one of the “most haunted” places in the U.S.
TAPS helps a family whose young children claim to be tormented by ghosts.

Sarah Drew, Patricia Heaton and Sean Astin star in this comedy about three mothers seeking a night off who get caught in chaos with lost babies, swapped cars, and a surprise police visit.

Teacher Adrien Murphy is the founder of after school program Kindness Club, where she inspires kids to give back to the community. Lacey shows Adrien that kindness comes back to you, with a surprise Glamp-out to remember.

Say Goodbye to the Grand Duchess of Greed, Part 1 (An Adventure in Generosity) – “It’s MY money, and you can’t tell me what to do with it!” Uh-oh, sounds like somebody is having second thoughts about paying their pledge to the Youth Group Fundraiser – and Lila is a member of the group! Is it already too late for Bibleman to save the day?!. Bible Story: Elijah And the Widow. Key Verses: Matthew 6:1-4

Christian decides to play ball with his friends instead of going to church. However, Christian invites Slim, who has never been to church, and as they hear the miraculous powers of Jesus, they both learn Jesus is the true Super Hero.

Holy Moly turns the Bible into a living, breathing colouring book that will delight children of all ages. Eyes will be fixed on the screen, observing how God is at work in the story when colour is introduced to an otherwise black-and-white world. Rather than dialogue, the series focuses on the Biblical characters’ actions and emotions to help audiences of any language or background immediately relate to and remember these enriching stories.
NEW SERIES! Come hangout with Lyds, Liam, Extra Bear, and Stu as they explore challenges, DIY projects, life tips, cool stuff, epic vids, and so much more in The Blello Show!
Join Pastor Steven in the Basin where he digs deep into scripture and breaks down the Word of God in these short conversational teachings.

Joel and a group of friends push off from the main lodge and head upriver into a stretch of water few people ever see. The bite is fast and constant, with walleye and northern pike filling the day with bent rods and steady action. When suppertime rolls around, the group discovers they’ve forgotten the oil — but northern improvisation saves the day. With a bit of butter they packed along, Joel cooks a golden, crackling pan fry over an open fire on the riverbank. The adventure continues as they move deeper upriver, spotting a cow moose and her calf feeding quietly along the shoreline. Back at camp, evenings are filled with home-cooked meals, including juicy moose burgers from the previous fall’s hunt. Exploring narrow creeks, roaring rapids, and hidden bends in the river, the crew experiences the pure excitement of remote-water fishing and northern wilderness life — the kind of trip where every turn reveals something new.
Jeni, joined by her close friends and family, is cooking up some of her favourite autumn foods like beef stew, chocolate chip cookies, and challah bread.
Is it still important for men to behave like gentlemen? These guests may surprise you with their answers. Luke Weston is today’s host, joined by Bjorn Brickell and Andrew Curtis.

A short documentary addressing one of the most pressing issue in Western society - The Fatherless Epidemic. While everyone attempts to solve societal ills by treating symptoms, the church is being called to fight the issue at its roots. The solution to curing the epidemic is not to outsource it to the government, but to mobilise the church and begin to wage war against the enemy that is decimating our homes.
This Award-Winning documentary follows 14 men and mountaineer Kevin DeVries on a trek to Everest Base Camp as he prepares to climb in the region after a cardiac arrest.

Explore the lands of the Bible and uncover a window into the ancient past. Read about places like Jericho, Jerusalem, Caesarea, and cities surrounding the Sea of Galilee, and discover that those places exist just as the Bible describes.

Gary Kent is the speaker for The Incredible Journey. He is an archaeologist who has excavated numerous sites throughout Israel and Jordan. He holds a BA in Theology, MA in Ancient History And Archaeology, and M in Divinity. As an internationally-acclaimed speaker and TV presenter, he has spoken and produced numerous documentaries on subjects including the Bible, Bible prophecy, world events, historical places and natural health. His passion is to share the good news of Jesus’ soon return.

Pastor Joseph Prince preaches dynamic messages centred on the pure gospel of the grace of God. His desire is to help believers understand grace and how greatly blessed, highly favoured and deeply loved they are by their heavenly Father.
Host Desiree Nielsen prepares some nutritious meals for someone with a busy lifestyle, including a breakfast burrito and a no-carbohydrate cauliflower pizza.
Host Desiree Nielsen presents some low-carbohydrate options that could be for any meal of the day, including some buckwheat pancakes that are smothered in blueberries.
Desiree Nielsen shows us how to add more plants to your plate with a chocolate avocado smoothie, nori rolls, and sweet potato noodles.

Desiree Nielsen blends veggie protein powder to make a pina colada smoothie, then she makes a batch of overnight oats topped with seasonal berries and reveals secrets for making appetizers on short time, such as pastry tarts with veggies and herbs.
Rice Balls Stuffed with Seafood and Pistachio Cannoli are on the menu as Chef Michael Bonacini explores dishes from the Italian island of Sicily.

Chef-host Shahir Massoud explores the award-winning cookbook Pasta Every Day by Meryl Feinstein, demonstrating how to make fresh pasta shapes including cavatelli, farfalle and gnocchi, all paired with delicious sauces.

With only 30 minutes and the clock ticking, can Vanessa make a movie night meal for 4 for about 40 bucks? On the menu: loaded turkey nachos, pizza flavored popcorn, spiced cucumber sticks, and chocolate covered pretzel sticks!

With only 30 minutes and the clock ticking, can Vanessa make an Izakaya-inspired meal for 4 for about 40 bucks? On the menu: chicken yakitori, chili lime edamame, miso soup, veggie tempura, and tuna sashimi!

Can Vanessa make a teatime spread for four for about $40 in just 30 minutes? Menu: cucumber sandwiches, ham and cheese devilled eggs, lemon scones with raspberry jam, and matcha white chocolate-covered strawberries.

Argentinian-born chef Natalia Machado makes grilled calamari salad, followed by grilled pizza, and then shows us how to make lamb ravioli, before finishing it off with the best-ever cookies: alfajores.

Unlock Gusto TV's top recipes on QR Countdown! Thousands of viewers scan our QR codes to access our delicious dishes. Now, we're serving up 8 of our most popular snack recipes, from hosts like Kyle Crawford and Vanessa Gianfrancesco.

While exploring the flavors of Mexico and Norway, the host prepares sweet corn flan, Arctic char with forage, two different types of taco-like dishes, and lamb ribs served with birch bark stuffed with masa and vegetables.

Re-join Chef Kimberly Lallouz in her One Big Recipe test kitchen as she masterfully creates a week night feast of baked feta with marinated tomatoes and corn chips, a marinated tomato and jicama salad with cilantro lime dressing, carne molida tacos, and a sous-vide crème caramel.

Game day traditions meet sizzling creativity as familiar favorites hit the griddle. From sliders to smoky wings, these dishes celebrate casual gatherings and the inventive ways home chefs turn everyday ingredients into shareable, crowd-pleasing bites.

Corine Carey, Leanne Sallenback, and Kelly Ireland travel to San Antonio, Texas, to answer the panicked calls of local residents who have experienced paranormal phenomena tied to the infamous Battle of the Alamo in 1836.

Corine, Leanne, and Kelly travel to Montreal to answer calls from frightened witnesses who are being haunted by ghosts related to the city's turbulent history from the early 1900's through to the end of the Prohibition in the 1930's.

Corine, Leanne and Kelly search for answers in Massachusetts, uncovering what Salem's ghosts reveal about the infamous witch trials, before receiving a chilling message from a man executed in the most gruesome way imaginable.

In Rhode Island, a couple calls in investigator Joe Cetrone after their flirtation with the occult unleashes a demonic spirit they cannot control. In Massachusetts, a ghost hunter disturbs an ancient evil spirit that will stop at nothing to get revenge. In Ohio, investigator Karlo Zuzic captures startling proof of a haunting in an historic building.

In New York, investigator Joe Cetrone battles a demonic entity intent on harming his own son. In Ohio, a child's imaginary friend is revealed to be something much darker when it starts to tear the family apart, and in an old Colorado jail, investigators are stalked by a dangerous doppelganger.

In an historic house in Massachusetts, ghost hunter Jack Kenna uncovers a shocking family secret that's been hidden for centuries. Investigators are called in to save a young teenager being attacked in her sleep, but the true identity of her assailant is alarming. In Kansas, another investigator has to decide between solving a mystery and saving his client's life.
Investigator Michelle Desrochers must go to extraordinary lengths to stop a terrifying demonic spirit attacking a four-year boy.

Marvel as a near-death experience helps a woman rekindle her ability to see the dead. Dig deeper into the mystery with Brandon and Mustafa, who start to suspect that she may have passed this supernatural skill down to her son as well.
Brandon and Mustafa explore Waverly Hills Sanatorium with guide Hailie, whose lifelong fascination with the hospital deepened after discovering her great-grandmother's own connection to the building.
A stunning find by complete strangers thousands of miles away helps Chad reconnect with the spirit of his Air Force pilot grandfather, inspiring him to dream big and take to the skies himself.
Explore the mystical ability that helps a caregiver soothe departing souls.
Say hello to a mom who reaches out to her loved ones from beyond the grave.
Carrie struggles to cope with the loss of her childhood best friend, finding solace in a solitary horse ride where a paranormal encounter shifts her perspective on life after death.

Michael describes a potential childhood tragedy where his grandfather reached out from beyond the grave to save his life, and he later learned that his relatives often downplayed paranormal occurrences of their own that occurred.

Step into Perryville Battlefield's Karrick-Parks House, where 7,600 Civil War spirits are said to linger. Meet the town's re-enactors as the team launches a bold experiment to document long-dead soldiers.

Ramsay's chefs must each prepare a Greek dish using their chosen protein. Meanwhile, Josh gives himself a bizarre motivational pep talk after being called out for poor leadership, baffling his fellow chefs.
Ramsay's chefs must create a dish using beer, wine or a spirit, judged by guest bartenders. Meanwhile, a slipped disc threatens Bret's progress in the competition.
Ramsay's chefs grab exotic proteins including alligator, wild boar and ostrich for their dishes. Winners head to the spa, while losers choke down a milkshake made from the leftovers.

Ramsay challenges the chefs to cook a Mardi Gras homecoming dinner for Calabasas High using seafood, chicken and beef. Meanwhile, the blue team must nominate their two weakest members before Gordon springs a surprise.

Ramsay's teams face a blind taste test for a shopping spree prize. At dinner service, the chefs serve a five-course meal for two charities. One chef's inexperience leads to another dramatic elimination.
Contestants hunt for locker keys to score steak cuts, then cook a dish in 35 minutes. Steak night returns at dinner service, but will one chef's repeated blunders lead to elimination?

Pairs of contestants battle it out in the Taste It and Make It challenge, with the winning duo visiting the Queen Mary ocean liner. After a dinner service filled with mistakes, can a perfectly cooked lamb dish save Josh from the chop?

The top five chefs have 45 minutes to create an elegant small plate for a private symphony audience. The winner scores a chopper tour of LA. At dinner service, each chef takes a nerve-racking turn as Gordon's sous chef.

The penultimate episode sees the best vegetarian dish win a parasailing experience and slap-up meal. Emotions run high as family visits, before a tense service where each contestant takes a turn as head chef. Who makes the final?

The final two chefs visit former winner Christina Wilson in Vegas for inspiration before cooking five dishes for legendary judges including Wolfgang Puck and Nancy Silverton. Who takes the top job at Gordon's Atlantic City restaurant?

Gordon Ramsay returns with 18 chefs vying for a top job at his Vegas restaurant. The series opens with an Army training test, followed by a 45-minute signature dish challenge. First dinner service feeds VIPs Nolan Gould and Erica Ash.

The chefs are challenged to create 10 savory crepes; the winning team heads to Santa Barbara to dine on a yacht, and the losers handle a fish delivery; VIP guests include actress Noureen De Wulf and actor Dash Mihok.

Gordon Ramsay's gruelling chef challenge continues. Tensions run high in the house as the teams face their next challenge, which is to make eight unique dishes using a selection of ostrich cuts. While the winners get to go to Big Bear for a zip-lining excursion, the losing chefs have to pluck pine nuts out of pine cones.

Gordon Ramsay's gruelling chef challenge continues. The contestants compete in a surf and turf protein relay for the chance to win a day of surfing in San Diego. Later, the pressure is on during dinner service when a table of pregnant women are among the night's guests.

Gordon Ramsay's gruelling chef challenge continues. A shock elimination forces both teams to regroup and chart a new course as they take on the Seven Seas Seafood Challenge, which gives the chefs just 30 minutes to prepare a fish dish using a variety of fresh ingredients. Later, guitarist Joe Perry and singer Estelle are invited to the dinner service.
Tarek and Christina take on one of their biggest projects to date in Anaheim Hills, but modernising this '90s mansion will cost them a fortune.
A couple decides to move to Italy so he can go back to school and pursue a whole new career.
A young woman brings her mother along to help her find an easy-to-maintain row home with renovation potential in Washington, DC.
Keith Bynum and Evan Thomas help a Detroit couple see that, with a little bit of work, they can have the home that works best for their family.
David hunts for a spacious home for a growing family who won big on a second chance drawing in Bangor, Maine.
Christina helps her good friend and business partner, Cara, and Cara's husband remodel their main bedroom and bath.

p.t: My Lottery Dream Home: Where Are They Now?
p.d: David Bromstad hops in the time machine to catch up with past winners in Massachusetts and Cleveland.
Having ended their romantic relationship but remaining business partners,two Flipping 101 graduates are chasing their biggest profit yet.
Dave and Jenny are in the final phase of their historic Centerton bank building renovation with the construction of a mercantile on the first floor.
A Baltimore family seeks an affordable, spacious home for their two kids and two dogs in the quiet town of Harrogate, England.
Tarek and Christina team up with their friend Pete De Best on a house in Yorba Linda, CA. They've flipped houses with Pete, but he's a penny pincher.
Christina helps a couple renovate their kitchen. She designs a modern look for the space but getting all the elements to match is a huge challenge.
Two pilots and expectant parents have sky-high dreams for their first flip, but turning a 650-square-foot home into a buyer's dream won't be easy.

p.d: David revisits unforgettable winners to see how their lottery dream homes and lives have transformed.
A Baltimore family seeks an affordable, spacious home for their two kids and two dogs in the quiet town of Harrogate, England.

In this episode, Adam and Jamie turn the Mythbusters shop into a boot camp, while the build team head off to their very own Cape Canaveral-San Francisco Bay-where they attempt to simulate a home made rocket powered flight, with Kari as the reluctant astronaut.

In this new episode, the MythBusters help cure the sick, they find a way to save dollars for drivers and they even prolong human life by helping prevent cartoon copycat killings! Who else offers you so much?

In this episode, Adam and Jamie unleash a deadly myth from a supermax prison, which sees them try to make a deadly weapon out of nothing more dangerous than newspaper and underwear. While they are being tested to their wits end, Grant, Kari and Tory unscrew the cap on some more vodka myths-the latest in an occasional series of tall tales about the popular Russian tipple.
It's planes, trains and propeller mobiles... Adam and Jamie tackle the mystery of the shredded plane.

Adam and Jamie test a myth that helium-filled footballs fly farther and hang longer than regulation balls, while Grant, Tory and Kari investigate if teeth are strong enough to withstand the force of a bullet.

This episode of MythBusters is a game of two halves: Kari, Grant and Tory investigate a world-famous myth from American history, while Adam and Jamie probe some rather unpleasant facts about flatulence.

In Helium Raft, get set for the biggest Mythbusters build ever. And yet it all starts so simply. The myth states that if you can fly if you fill a normal raft with helium, because helium is lighter than air.

It's a constant source of frustration that not all of the testing footage can be included in the final show that goes to air. In this special episode, the outtakes are in, with never before seen footage and experiments from the MythBusters vault.

A Mythbusters episode without controversy is about as rare as a duck in a tree. But in this episode, there's more controversy than a year's worth of Jerry Springer, as the team returns to some of the most controversial myths - the myths that generated a truck load of angry fan mail - and puts them back under the microscope.

In Exploding Paint Adam and Jamie do a little painting and detonating when they attempt to blow wide open a home improvement myth. The story, from the TV archives, shows a lazy British comedian using dynamite to decorate.

These days there are fashion disasters aplenty. Just pick up any celebrity magazine and you’ll find who’s dressing hot and who’s not. Whether it be outrageous at the Oscars or minging it at MTV, fashion faux pas are an every day occurrence.

Archimedes: to some he is the greatest mathematician the world has ever seen. To others, he is a philosophical inventor without parallel. But to the Mythbusters, he’s proving to be one big pain in the neck.
Are there whirlpools powerful enough to swallow entire ships? And, Tory, Kari and Grant attempt to bust the myth that a snowplough travelling on a highway blew an oncoming car off the road.
Myths tested: Can a laser alarm be defeated? Can a metal duct be stealthily climbed using magnets? Can a pressure switch be defeated? How easy is it to crack a safe?

This special episode of MythBusters is quite literally a perfect storm. That’s because Adam and Jamie are putting Tornados to the test and they are joined by The Storm Chasers-Reed Timmer and Sean Casey.

Kenya’s making a massive move towards setting up the country's first community-run rhino sanctuary. Find out why Lewa reckons it's the right call, and watch the teams as they shift rhinos from all over the shop to this new conservancy.
Kenyan capture teams head to the Somalian border to find 50 rare antelopes and bring them to a safe enclosure, where their numbers can recover.
Engage in a game of cat and mouse with nature’s top mimics and stealthy hunters.
Love and war go hand in hand, for there are hunters who cooperate to maximize their captures and others who turn neglected lovers into a fast and easy meal.
Two blue penguins are followed along New Zealand's southern coast to reveal their personal journeys to find mates so that they can reproduce.
New Zealand's west coast is like nowhere else. From glacier-covered mountains and rain-drenched native forests to rough frigid seas, the landscape defies belief.
In New Zealand, two wild fortresses protect the vulnerable native animals: One a remote island protected by a moat of saltwater, the other a hilltop citadel surrounded by a predator-proof barrier.

Sharks are among the planet’s oldest and most highly evolved predators. Along southern Africa’s coast, pioneers dedicate their lives to learning more about these creatures, and spreading awareness about their plight. These people do all they can to find safe ways of living with sharks.
Epic natural wonders are uncovered in the remote American southwest desert. From vast canyons bound by towering cliffs to red striped fossilized dunes, the Paria Plateau is a geologic marvel.
The islands of the Bahamas are a haven for the migratory birds, green turtles and rock iguanas that find sanctuary in the archipelago's sandstone cliffs, underwater caves and pink-sand beaches.
Ring-tailed lemurs live their best life in Anja Reserve, Madagascar.
The island is the land of Lemurs. Lemurs are fascinating arboreal primitive primates of Madagascar represented in all sizes, colors, and shapes from the largest Indri to the tiny mouse lemur.
Meet two fascinating primates: The Samango monkeys and the Cape Parrots.

There’s watery fun with group two as they visit group three’s flooded classroom. Ayu, Ruthie, and Kesi take a step closer to release. And the arrival of Alba - the world’s rarest orangutan - creates a sensation at Orangutan Jungle School.

Now that albino orangutan Alba’s here, how will her classmates react? Plus, take a tour of the nursery school, see how Beni deals with a big bully, and watch as a few feisty females find their place in a new hierarchy.

We'll bring you all of the confessions, meltdowns, chair throws, funny moments and the heartfelt stories!

Keith has been accused of touching his 3-year-old son inappropriately by the mother of his children, which he strongly denies. He says this is the result of her anger over an affair he had. But will the lie detector test prove him right?

Nicole thinks Sean openly cheats on her, but she's the one who gets the positive test result; Imani sports the promise ring from Charles, but she may have to return it after contracting a sexually transmitted disease.
Ashley and DeNorris accuse each other of cheating; Jim denies having sex with his fiancee's sister and underage girls.
A woman demands a paternity test so that the father of her child will financially support his child; a man demands a paternity tests.

Bobbie says that her daughter Cindy’s home was filled with so many dangerous animals that she was forced to report her to child protective services because she felt her grandchild was in danger. But Cindy says Bobbie has another agenda!
On today's Steve Wilkos, will the lie detector results reveal if Tamisha and Simone's men were faithful? Or will it reveal some more sinister results?
Kendra says her boyfriend makes her feel like a prisoner in her own home and accuses her of seducing neighbors through the window; Keisha believes that her husband cheats on her when he is at work.

A woman wants to prove to her boyfriend that their baby girl really is his despite the fact that she cheated on him before getting pregnant; a couple disputes whether or not the girlfriend is being unfaithful and selling her body for money.

Sherry was raped at 15 and ran away from home. She’s asked for Steve’s help to reunite her with her mother. Then, Dawn's teenage daughter Cathy recently gave birth, but lives in fear of the baby’s unemployed and abusive father Nick.
At 13 years old, Meghan had issues with alcohol and now she is addicted to heroin.
Vanessa reveals a secret she’s been hiding from her boyfriend. Melissa will find out if Joel fathered her son!
Dytazia wants to know if her mother tried to sell her for drugs; a young boy dies while in the care of a relative; Kristie wants to know who her biological father is.

Michael and Flora are no longer dating, but they have a 3 year old daughter together. Michael thinks that Flora’s boyfriend Dwayne is abusing his daughter, but is he telling the truth? Watch Steve get to the bottom of this!

They say the terrible teens can be a trying time for parents. But 13 year old Kendra is really giving her parents a run for their money. Her father says that she's been caught smoking weed, having sex and even cutting herself.

One of Australia's greatest detectives reveals the stories of his most challenging cases. This series takes you behind the news headlines on a minute by minute journey with detective Ron Iddles.

Plagued by nightmares, Teyla investigates what might be causing them. Alarmingly, she discovers she's a descendant of humans who were experimented on by the Wraith.

With a group of Wraith hive ships on the way to Atlantis, the team searches for a place to flee and a way to destroy the city. McKay leads a team to try and activate the Ancients' orbital weapons platform.
The Wraith are closing in... Could Atlantis really be doomed?
The Atlantis team are back, facing the impending destruction of the lost city. There's no respite as the Wraith plan a fresh assault...

The battle cruiser Daedalus becomes infected with a virus that may allow the Wraith to take over the ship, and McKay fights to prevent this from happening. Meanwhile, a meeting at the SGC reveals the Pentagon's plans to replace Major Sheppard with Colonel Caldwell. David Hewlett stars.
A fierce warrior on the run could be the team's only hope in saving Ford, who's been infected by the Wraith. Top sci-fi action.
A technical glitch during their rescue from a Wraith ship forces McKay and Cadman to co-exist inside McKay's body.
The team visits a technologically advanced planet. And oddly, its inhabitants remain unharmed by the Wraith.
McKay stumbles onto a new, potent source of energy for Atlantis based on Ancient technology. But it's yet to be perfected...

Beckett begins experimenting with a new treatment that could turn the Wraiths into humans. The team finds a young Wraith girl, who could be Beckett's first patient. Having been raised by a human, the girl is eager, and reckless, to try anything.
Dr Beckett realizes that the 'retrovirus' Ellia ingested is now in Sheppard's bloodstream... and he's mutating into the very creature that attacked him.
The crew discovers a decrepit warship whose ancient crew are frozen in stasis pods and live in a virtual world. But it's a world infiltrated by a Wraith in disguise...

While exploring a new planet, Sheppard, McKay, Teyla and Ronon are ambushed by a group of men armed with Wraith stunners. They awaken to find themselves prisoners in a cave, where they discover the mastermind behind the attack: Lt. Aiden Ford.
The enzyme's grip on the team begins to lessen, sending them into withdrawal as they try to escape from the Wraith hive ship.

The Outer Banks bluefin season is led by an unexpected Northern captain, but when the Southern fleet steps up their game even more surprises are on the horizon. Are the local fleets efforts enough to change the competition? With the quota dwindling, fishing twenty-four seven is the only option and none of the boats are backing down as the North Carolina Bluefin season heats up.

Greg Mayer is unexpectedly injured, and he is forced to spend time ashore in order to focus on recovering properly, so the other boats seize on the chance to try and pull ahead by working as hard as possible to ensure their catch attempts succeed.

The Northern boats’ success continues to frustrate the Southern fishermen. The crew on the Fishing Frenzy is feeling the pressure to catch fish without Captain Greg Mayer. Every catch can change the leaderboard, and the Frenzy crew members are determined to make their captain proud. Meanwhile, Captain Nick Gowitzka of the Little Shell looks to break out of the middle of the standings.

Captain Greg Mayer returns to the helm of the Fishing Frenzy, despite battling a painful shoulder injury. Although his crew has managed the boat well in his absence, Greg knows that the dwindling quota means that every catch matters, and he’s determined to lead his team to victory. Meanwhile, Captain Dale Lisi and his crew on the Foolish Pleasures are having their worst season ever.

As the bluefin quota counts down, the end of the season is near. Captain Tyler McLaughlin finds himself without a mate on the Pinwheel and weighs the risky decision to fish solo, despite the warnings of the other captains. The Outer Banks is treacherous even for the most experienced captains, and fishing alone can be a dangerous gamble.
Captain Greg Mayer is barely holding onto his lead, and the other captains are determined to knock him down.

There’s only forty-eight hours left in the Outer Banks Bluefin season, and while a Southern boat leads the fleet, one Northern vessel continues their assault for the top- earning spot. With final paychecks on the line, big fish on the hook and so little time, a fight to the finish is the only guarantee.

It’s opening day of bluefin season in the Outer Banks, and a new Southern fleet is ready to take on the Northern captains and bring home lucrative first fish. Captain Zack Shackleton of the Rasta Rocket wants to prove that his 28-foot 2000 Contender can compete with boats twice its size; Pinwheel Captain Tyler McLaughlin is determined to win his first season down south with his sister by his side.

When a dangerous decision leaves Reel E’ Bugging stranded, Captain Bobby Earl’s crew struggles to prove its place in the competition and catch its first bluefin. Meanwhile, Hot Tuna fights to extend its lead in first place and keep a Northern boat on top. Determined to get ahead, Kahuna, Rasta Rocket and Offshore Outlaw fish hard in order to launch the local boats up the leaderboard.
Southern boat Rasta Rocket sets out to prove that the little boat can be big competition.
In this Outer Banks or Bust edition, the fleet learns that, without local knowhow, theres no chance of conquering this challenging fishery.
